rule: S_N must not be null
rationale: S_N is the primary identifier and one-to-one join key with Acc_Info_dirty. Mandatory business field with 0% missing in sample but required for referential integrity.

rule: S_N must exist in Acc_Info_dirty.S_N
rationale: S_N is designated as a one-to-one key with Acc_Info_dirty.S_N. Every record must have a matching counterpart in the sibling table.

rule: Account_No must not be null
rationale: Account_No is a mandatory business identifier for customer accounts. No missing values observed but field is required.

rule: Name must not be null
rationale: Customer name is a mandatory demographic field with 0% missing values.

rule: Name must be in Title Case (excluding lowercase particles bin, binte, d/o, s/o)
rationale: Evidence shows deterministic casing deviations: 'lim wei jie' (all lowercase) and 'WANG SHI JIE' (all uppercase). Standard requires Title Case with exceptions for cultural patronymic particles.

check_params.logic: any(w[0].islower() or w.isupper() for w in str(row['Name']).split() if w.lower() not in ('bin','binte','d/o','s/o') and len(w) > 1)

rule: ID_No must not be null
rationale: National ID is a mandatory identifier field with 0% missing values.

rule: ID_No must match Singapore NRIC/FIN format: one letter (S, T, F, G), 7 digits, one uppercase letter
rationale: Evidence shows 6.6% format deviations: '1916569C' missing prefix, 'F212233V' has only 6 digits. Standard Singapore format requires prefix letter + 7 digits + checksum.

rule: ID_No must not contain placeholder sentinel values
rationale: Evidence shows 'F0000000X' which uses all zeros in the digit section, indicating a test or placeholder value rather than a valid issued identifier.

rule: Race must not be null
rationale: Race is a mandatory demographic classification field with 0% missing values.

rule: Race must be one of: Chinese, Malay, Indian
rationale: Evidence shows case inconsistencies (MALAY, malay, indian) but only three semantic categories exist. Standardising to canonical Title Case values.

rule: Gender must not be null
rationale: Gender is a mandatory demographic field with 0% missing values.

rule: Gender must be one of: Male, Female
rationale: Evidence shows case inconsistencies (male, FEMALE) representing two semantic categories. Standardising to canonical Title Case values.

rule: Age must not be null
rationale: Age is a mandatory demographic field with 0% missing values.

rule: Age must be numeric parseable
rationale: Evidence shows 3.3% non-numeric text value 'Twenty-five' that cannot be parsed as a number in an int64 column.

rule: Age must be between 0 and 120 inclusive
rationale: Evidence shows invalid negative value (-5) and unrealistic value (4) for service accounts. Human age domain constraint requires non-negative values below 120.

rule: Contact_No must not be null
rationale: Contact number is a mandatory contact field with 6.7% observed missing values (2 NULLs) requiring validation.

rule: Contact_No must be a valid Singapore phone number: +65 prefix, 8 digits, starting with 6, 8, or 9
rationale: Evidence shows Singapore country code (65) in sample values, 8-digit local numbers, and one anomalous 7-digit value ('8964359'). Singapore phone numbers are 8 digits starting with 6 (landline), 8, or 9 (mobile).

rule: Email must not be null
rationale: Email is a mandatory contact field with 0% missing values.

rule: Email must contain exactly one @ symbol with no whitespace
rationale: Evidence shows 13.3% structurally malformed values: missing @ ('not-an-email', 'useremail.com'), embedded space ('zx91 @example.com'), and double @ ('nabilah@@example.com').

rule: Country must not be null
rationale: Country is a mandatory geographic field with 0% missing values.

rule: Country must be 'Singapore'
rationale: Evidence shows 8 distinct representations of Singapore (case variants, abbreviations S'pore/SG, local language Singapura/新加坡, formal Republic of Singapore). Standardising to canonical English form.

rule: Street_Name must not be null
rationale: Street name is a mandatory address component with 0% missing values.

rule: Street_Name must be in Title Case
rationale: Evidence shows deterministic casing deviation: 'HOLLAND ROAD' appears in all-caps (3.3% of records) while dominant convention is Title Case.

check_params.logic: any(w[0].islower() or w.isupper() for w in str(row['Street_Name']).split() if len(w) > 1)

rule: Postal_Code must not be null
rationale: Postal code is a mandatory address component with 0% missing values.

rule: Postal_Code must be exactly 6 digits (Singapore standard)
rationale: Evidence shows values with 4 digits (6907) and 5 digits (99999) due to leading zero loss during integer storage. Singapore postal codes require exactly 6 digits.

rule: Name particles indicating gender must match Gender column: Bin/s/o indicate Male; Binte/d/o indicate Female
rationale: Multicultural naming conventions encode gender in particles: Malay 'Bin' and Indian 's/o' (son of) indicate male; Malay 'Binte' and Indian 'd/o' (daughter of) indicate female. Mismatches indicate data inconsistency.

check_params.logic: ((re.search(r'\bBin\b', str(row['Name']), re.IGNORECASE) or re.search(r'\bs/o\b', str(row['Name']), re.IGNORECASE)) and str(row['Gender']).strip().lower() != 'male') or ((re.search(r'\bBinte\b', str(row['Name']), re.IGNORECASE) or re.search(r'\bd/o\b', str(row['Name']), re.IGNORECASE)) and str(row['Gender']).strip().lower() != 'female')

rule: Name must match Full_Name in Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N
rationale: S_N is a one-to-one key between tables. The Name field in this table should be consistent with Full_Name in the sibling account table for the same individual.

check_params.semantic_check: Name must match Full_Name exactly (case-sensitive string equality)

rule: ID_No must match ID in Acc_Info_dirty for the same S_N
rationale: S_N is a one-to-one key between tables. The national identifier ID_No must be consistent with the ID field in the sibling account table (e.g., S8421753J must match S8421753X is a violation).

check_params.semantic_check: ID_No must match ID exactly (case-sensitive string equality)

rule: S_N must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty (one-to-one join key)
rationale: One-to-one key relationship detected by MinHash analysis; duplicate values break the join.

rule: Account_No must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty
rationale: Column is 93.3% distinct with duplicate value(s) [1001, 1010] observed; treated as a candidate identifier — duplicates flagged for review.

rule: ID_No must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty
rationale: Column is 96.7% distinct with duplicate value(s) ['F1011121T'] observed; treated as a candidate identifier — duplicates flagged for review.

rule: Email must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty
rationale: Column is 96.7% distinct with duplicate value(s) ['thm@example.com'] observed; treated as a candidate identifier — duplicates flagged for review.

rule: Account_No must be a 4-digit code
rationale: Dominant observed format is 4 digits (derived from data distribution). Values of different lengths are likely truncated, padded, or sentinel values.

rule: Postal_Code must be a 6-digit code
rationale: Dominant observed format is 6 digits (derived from data distribution). Values of different lengths are likely truncated, padded, or sentinel values.
